matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 391-400 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. Pages 396, 397, and 398 retain their earlier authoritative reviewed-after-correction decisions for the Alfred Roch, David Rodnick, and Charlene Roland middle-initial or rank column shifts. The other seven pages match the current extraction and require no correction. Literal source anomalies, duplicates, variants, clipped note text, unusual placements, and apparent typographical errors remain unchanged. Examples preserved include the clipped Richardson-Be surname; John Gatlin Riddick with Gatlin in the printed M I column; Leonard C Riley with 6894898RA in the identifier column; Sidney D Ripley II with Dr. in the printed first-name field; Fabiola M Robert followed by H B Robert and Henry F Robert; a duplicate-looking H B Roberts in the next box; Nancy J Robertson with a blank rank and occupied identifier cell; Roosevelt relationship notes clipped at the table boundary; John M Rosenfield III; Alfred Rosenhal; and the unusually long printed identifiers for Fred R Riveglia, Adrion N Ross, and Alfred J Ross. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
